provider.name: REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

value.text:
- document:
  - banner:
    - link "Hood Warfare home":
      - /url: /
      - text: HOOD WARFARE
    - navigation "Game options":
      - button "SOUND ON" [pressed]
      - button "Controls"
  - main:
    - region "Start a match":
      - heading "PLAY HOOD WARFARE" [level=1]
      - paragraph: Your corner. Your crew. Your rules.
      - button "Start playing"
      - paragraph: Team Deathmatch · Easy bots · 3 minutes
      - paragraph: No account needed. Move, aim, and shoot — we will guide your first round.
      - group: Change mode or bot difficulty
      - text: DISPLAY NAME
      - textbox "DISPLAY NAME": Player
      - text: CHARACTER
      - combobox "CHARACTER":
        - option "ACE — varsity" [selected]
        - option "NOVA — street cap"
        - option "MICA — olive jacket"
        - option "JET — gold trim"
      - button "Find a match"
      - button "Invite friends"
      - textbox "Friend room code":
        - /placeholder: ROOM CODE
      - button "Join"
      - button "Local practice"
      - status
    - status
  - contentinfo:
    - text: WASD MOVE MOUSE SHOOT R RELOAD SPACE JUMP CTRL / C CROUCH
    - navigation "Game site links":
      - link "How to play":
        - /url: /how-to-play
      - link "Leaderboard":
        - /url: /leaderboards
      - link "Privacy":
        - /url: /privacy
      - link "Terms":
        - /url: /terms
  - dialog "Phone controls. Faster first match.":
    - banner:
      - text: WHAT'S NEW v0.4.1 · October 15, 2026
      - button "Close announcement for today": ×
      - heading "Phone controls. Faster first match." [level=2]
    - paragraph: "The block is easier to jump into. Here is what has changed:"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - heading "Play on your phone" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Move with the left pad, drag to look, and hold FIRE. Jump, reload, switch guns, aim, sprint, and crouch with touch buttons.
      - listitem:
        - heading "One click to Easy bots" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Play now starts Team Deathmatch with Easy bots. Change the mode or difficulty whenever you are ready.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Learn while you play" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Your first round guides you through moving, looking, and firing, with feedback for your first hit and takedown.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Bring your crew" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Choose Team Deathmatch or Turf War, try three bot difficulties, or invite friends and play another round together.
    - contentinfo:
      - button "Got it — close for today"
      - paragraph: This update stays closed for today. A new update may appear again.
  - alert

Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and never wait for unfinished responses or refetch them.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
